title: Your saved data
description: Save a copy of your places or restore a backup.
crashMessage: Try again or restore a backup.
savedFileDescription: Keep the original file, even if PastPins can’t read it.
noSavedFile: There’s no saved file to copy.
diagnosticsDescription: Review a technical report and email it to support.
nativeInstructions: In iPhone Settings, turn on “Reset on Next Launch” for PastPins. Close PastPins from the app switcher, then reopen it. This deletes your data on this iPhone.
nativeUnavailable: Reset from Settings is available in the installed PastPins app.
nativeResetWarning: Erases all PastPins data and settings when the app next starts. Backups saved outside the app and iOS permissions stay. Close PastPins from the app switcher, then reopen it. Turn this off before reopening to cancel.

errors.invalid-document: PastPins couldn’t read your saved places. Your file hasn’t been changed.
errors.unsupported-version: Update PastPins to open these places. They were saved with a newer app version.
errors.storage-read: PastPins couldn’t access your saved places. Try again in a moment.
errors.storage-write: Your changes could not be saved. Check the available storage on your iPhone and try again.
errors.reset-failed: The reset didn’t finish. Try again, or use “Reset on Next Launch” in iPhone Settings for PastPins.
